name: burninguard-ai
description: BurnInGuard AI 2.0 - Physics-informed, explainable PASS/FAIL prediction for component burn-in screening

scripts.prediction:csv: cd backend && python predict.py --input prediction_input.csv --output outputs/prediction_output.csv
scripts.test: cd backend && python -m pytest tests/ -v && cd frontend && npm test
scripts.clean: cd backend && del /s /q outputs\*.csv outputs\jobs\ outputs\audit_jobs.json outputs\review_actions.json models\*.pkl && cd frontend && rmdir /s /q dist 2>nul
